facts.behavior: Curse lookup matches hero and family. An absent family reports power1 if another family exists, otherwise0.
Mode3 removes all families for the hero and restores slot artifacts; mode0 only deletes matching rows.
Daily processing is owner-scoped; expiry uses signed start+length < current day.
Family4 subtracts power from gold using signed DWORD addition, then clamps negative gold to0.
Family65 adds power directly to the movement DWORD.
DailyCurse runs before original timers in daily turn setup.

definedException: The original leaves the missing-curse duration output undefined. The port writes0, as authorized.
sourceUse: Unchanged zc3-0 initializers HE0:Y4/500/999/1 and HE0:Y65/175/2/1; later OB69/68 replaces gold tax with990.
